articles.title: French mayor attacked by settlers in West Bank says Israel ‘tolerates’ settler violence
articles.summary: The French mayor who was attacked on Saturday by Israeli settlers in the occupied West Bank said the incident showed that Israel tolerates settler violence. “I think that if settlers are behaving like this, there is a tolerance on the part of the Israeli government,” said Bernard Baudoux, mayor of the northern French town of Aulnoye-Aymeries, speaking to AFP after the attack during a goodwill visit to the Palestinian village of Taybeh. “The whole world needs to know what’s happening there. articles.title: Belgium condemns Israeli settler attack on European diplomats in West Bank
articles.summary: Belgium on Saturday condemned an attack by Israeli settlers on a convoy of European diplomats in the occupied West Bank, during which a visiting French mayor was beaten. Israeli Foreign Minister Gideon Saar also condemned the attack, describing it as violence by “rioters”. "I strongly condemn the severe acts of violence by Israeli rioters in the area of Taybeh," Saar said, while faulting the diplomats for not coordinating their visit with the Israeli military. articles.title: UN says West Bank olive harvest settler attacks surpass 2025 figure
articles.summary: The United Nations Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs (Ocha) reports that the number of settler attacks in the West Bank affecting the olive harvest season has already exceeded last year’s number. So far this year, nearly 200 settler attacks linked to the olive harvest have caused casualties or property damage, Ocha said in a statement.
